set.body: Introduce the duality diagram (X, row metric D, column metric Q) as a small validated base representation in modules/multivar. Acceptance: a DualityDiagram value checks table/space/metric dimensions and optional metric space tags; row and column dual operators plus total inertia are canonical methods; existing GenPcaKernels compatibility calls delegate through the diagram; GenPca can fit from a diagram without breaking current callers; tests cover construction errors, dual nonzero eigenvalue agreement, total inertia, transpose symmetry, and GenPca equivalence on JVM and JS.
set.title: Multivar duality diagram base representation
